title: Unable to build TensorFlow using installers 0.1.1-3

labels.name: P3
labels.description: We're not considering working on this, but happy to review a PR. (No assignee)

body:
Cross post from https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/772#issuecomment-171735296

I run into the same problem when running

```
bazel build -c opt --config=cuda //tensorflow/tools/pip_package:build_pip_package
```

bazel 0.1.1 and 0.1.3 give this error immediately

